name: Endless Kiteboarding
summary: A kitesurfing school at Silver Rock on the south coast, where steady cross shore trade winds make for a safe place to learn. Owner and senior instructor Roland Boyce has taught with the IKO since 2004, and the school also teaches surfing and windsurfing. Kites, boards, wing foils and other gear are for hire.
standouts: Senior instructor Roland Boyce, an IKO instructor since 2004 and a BKSA instructor
A minute's walk from the Silver Rock Hotel on the south coast
Rents Slingshot kites and boards, wing foils, windsurf, surf and SUP boards

trips.title: Kitesurfing lessons
trips.summary: Kitesurfing lessons with IKO qualified instructors on Silver Sands, taught as a group of two to four or one to one. The school paces each lesson to the student, and most people need six to ten hours to learn to ride on their own. Lessons use the Slingshot school range of kites and boards.
highlights: Group lessons for 2 to 4 people, or private one-on-one
Normally 6 to 10 hours of lessons to kiteboard independently
Taught on the latest Slingshot school range

trips.title: Surfing lessons
trips.summary: Surf lessons for beginners, taught one to one or in small groups, with gear included in the private rate. The school uses Prolimit longboards, which make small waves easier to catch.
trips.checkNotes: Currency not stated on this page, shown as $; the kitesurf and rental pages say all prices are in US dollars. Group surf prices are not given ('Contact us at +1 246 420-3253'). Surf spot not stated. Page last changed January 2019.

trips.title: Windsurfing lessons
trips.summary: Windsurfing lessons for complete beginners and for anyone wanting a refresher, covering control, tacks and how to sail and stay upwind. Both teaching areas are on flat water on the south coast.
highlights: From complete beginner to refresher course
Covers control, various types of tacks and sailing upwind
Two flat water teaching areas on the south coast
Group lessons for 2 to 4 beginners, or private
